Let me understand the data. Order information has Order Date (timestamp), Product Category, Sales, Quantity, Discount, profit, Shipping Cost, etc. Note that Order Date column seems to have inconsistent year vs Month (e.g., "2024-09-15" but Month says "Nov"). So we should use the year from Order Date.

Let me explore the data more - count rows, check categories, years, etc.

function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT substr(\"Order Date\",1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_information GROUP BY yr"}

messages.reasoning_content: Good. So we have 4 categories: Auto & Accessories, Electronic, Home & Furniture, Fashion. 51,289 rows total, spread across 2022-2024. Let me compute the profit margin (profit / Sales) by category and year.

function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT "Product Category", 
       substr("Order Date",1,4) AS yr,
       SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(Sales) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(profit)*1.0/SUM(Sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_information
GROUP BY "Product Category", yr
ORDER BY "Product Category", yr"}
